overall: No violation: distributing three members' candidate slates by email to a quorum, without commentary, for discussion at a meeting was administrative, not deliberation. The AG cautioned against using email this way. Issued before Boelter (2018), which may supersede it.

allegations.summary: Alleged that member-submitted slates of superintendent search committee candidates, emailed to a quorum before a meeting, were deliberation outside a noticed meeting.
allegations.key_passage: We therefore find that the distribution of the slates to a quorum of the Committee for the purpose of discussion in a meeting was an administrative task and not deliberation.
